title: The Sealed Letter
text: An unsigned letter sealed in black wax offers your House a rival's secrets: their debts, their dead, the name of the Scion they fear to lose. The price is a lock of hair from one of your own.

options.label: Send a lock of hair from one of your own; a rival's secrets are worth a little hair.

outcomes.text: Every one of the secrets is true.
The secrets are true. Every night since, the Scion whose hair you sent has woken feeling a hand on their head.

options.label: Burn the letter unread; no secret is worth what it asks.

outcomes.text: The wax will not burn. You bury it under the chapel floor instead, and the floor is warm there.

options.label: Carry it unopened to the rival House, to warn them someone is selling them.

outcomes.text: The rival is shaken and grateful, and now owes you. The city hears of it.
